defect: the generated clock names clk_b as master although the mux is fixed to clk_a
rationale: The retained mux select is a constant selecting clk_a, so mux_clk follows clk_a. The generated-clock source is clk_b, giving state_q the wrong master period and relationship.

mutation.description: Used clk_b as the -source of mux_clk even though the fixed select selects clk_a.

author: gpt-5.6-luna

provenance.adaptation: Retained the two-clock mux shape and a register clocked by its output; reduced the synchronized glitch-free selection logic to a fixed selection point.

labels.by: claude-sonnet (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: SELECT_A=0 makes mux_clk follow clk_a, but the generated clock uses clk_b as source.
